sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the details equipment 
inspection I1, which must be performed on every six months as indicated by M6 in 
the above title block.

This pump is used to transfer 
the coolant water from Nile River to condenser for condensing the steam from 
turbine to condensate water.

sections.text:
The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Abou Elfetouh Shata, tested by eng. Ali 
Abd Elslam, revised by EDEPC quality control engineer Abouda Elbana, accepted by 
general director eng. Yosry Abd Elmaqsood, and approved by eng. Fathy Ragab head 
sector of Talkha Power Station.

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس. سمير عبد الجليل؛ 
 مدير عام التفتيش وضبط الجودة EDEPC منسق MPIS ومعتمد من المحاسب محمود سليمان 
 EDEPC المدير العام للتفتيش المالي ومراقبة الجودة و 
 مشرف قطاع التفتيش وضبط الجودة.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued, the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.

Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes.... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor .
Disconnect electric terminal of the pump motor .

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing 
 delivery and suction valves
